comment: Bundled dictionary manifest. It DECLARES the built-in wordlists CaseKey ships with; it never contains password data itself. Each 'path' is resolved relative to this manifest's directory. The wordlist files are supplied separately (see README.md in this directory) and may be absent in a source checkout, in which case CaseKey shows the entry as 'file not supplied' and never fabricates candidates.

dictionaries.description: A general-purpose wordlist for the default Dictionary attack. A broad set of common passwords and passphrases; a sensible first pass that requires no knowledge of the specific case.
dictionaries.source: Curated by CaseKey contributors from openly redistributable sources.

dictionaries.description: A small, fast wordlist for a quick triage pass: the most common passwords only. Finishes in seconds and requires no case knowledge.
dictionaries.source: Curated by CaseKey contributors from openly redistributable sources.
